claims.statement: Case/card/date/plan-blind input and read-only method description
claims.source_grounding_reason: Case/input pins and current carrier agree; card contains unavoidable treatment cue. Session behavior and sequence are deferred to stage 2.

claims.statement: No mutation, credentials, live calls or execution occurred
claims.source_grounding_reason: Scope matches brief; current-only sources cannot prove acquisition execution history. No completed live test is asserted.

claims.statement: RQ1-RQ9 cover versions, comparison, policies, gaps, context, auth, failure inputs, scale and simpler alternatives
claims.source_grounding_reason: These are research questions and relevant hypotheses, not completed provider findings.

claims.statement: Question/query links, dead ends and all source URLs exist in scheduling/acquisition files
claims.source_grounding_reason: Those files are history-gated and unavailable to this standalone report; labels alone do not prove records.

claims.statement: Failed search is not proof of absence
claims.source_grounding_reason: Correct epistemic limitation; no corpus-wide negative finding follows from search failure.

claims.statement: PR versions use iterations; iteration 1 is source head at creation; numeric 1..maximum IDs
claims.source_grounding_reason: Supported in iterationId parameter and iteration model.

claims.statement: Every source push creates exactly +1 iteration for all PRs
claims.source_grounding_reason: Normal iteration-enabled behavior is supported, but supportsIterations and the >100000 modified-file exception qualify universality.

claims.statement: Target-branch movement never creates an iteration and changes merge-base comparisons
claims.source_grounding_reason: Target-dependent comparisons and build invalidation are real; frozen commonRefCommit/targetRefCommit and retarget/rebase reasons do not justify a blanket live recomputation rule.

claims.statement: Force-push/amend yields new review changeset rather than commit-count versioning
claims.source_grounding_reason: Force-pushed changesets preserve update history; IterationReason includes forcePush.

claims.statement: TFVC/GitHub semantics do not automatically transfer; using SHA list loses iteration anchoring
claims.source_grounding_reason: Scope caveat and design-risk inference are sensible; no comparative TFVC/GitHub contract was cited.

claims.statement: Iterations List URI, api-version=7.1 and includeCommits=true
claims.source_grounding_reason: Exact operation and optional parameter match.

claims.statement: Single iteration GET is available at iterations/{iterationId} with 7.1
claims.source_grounding_reason: Also pinned source X012 operation/URI, independently compatible with List model.

claims.statement: Repository/project accept ID or name and vso.code reads iterations
claims.source_grounding_reason: URI parameter and Security scope match.

claims.statement: includeCommits can avoid N+1 fetches; always fetching commits can cost more
claims.source_grounding_reason: Reasonable implementation option; hasMoreCommits means same response is not guaranteed to include every commit.

claims.statement: Changes URI supports $compareTo=0 common commit, explicit iteration, $top/$skip
claims.source_grounding_reason: Comparison and paging parameters match.

claims.statement: Single iteration vs predecessor and range 2-4 vs iteration 1 are client conventions
claims.source_grounding_reason: Owner README confirms exact examples; properly distinguished from provider contract.

claims.statement: Default compare means what would merge; pairwise means changes since last look
claims.source_grounding_reason: Helpful shorthand; mergeability itself requires more than change metadata and selected commits must stay pinned.

claims.statement: Client convention is optional UX and latest-only hides inter-version comparison
claims.source_grounding_reason: Correct scope and fit with earlier-work comparison requirement.

claims.statement: Get PR documents skip/top/maxCommentLength as Not used; includeCommits/includeWorkItemRefs useful
claims.source_grounding_reason: All five parameter decisions match.

claims.statement: Comment volume must be managed via Threads API
claims.source_grounding_reason: Threads are a relevant read path, but their List does not document a universal pager or automatic truncation control.

claims.statement: Vote values 10/5/0/-5/-10 have five distinct documented labels
claims.source_grounding_reason: Exact scale is supported by current API 7.1.

claims.statement: Groups cannot vote directly; member votes roll up; isRequired marks required reviewers
claims.source_grounding_reason: IdentityRefWithVote.votedFor/isRequired match.

claims.statement: Only 10 counts as full approval; 5 must never be rounded up
claims.source_grounding_reason: Preserving distinct labels is supported; provider docs also describe 5 as approving with optional suggestions. The third-party acceptance filter is not proof of Azure policy eligibility.

claims.statement: Identical vote semantics in 6.0/7.0/7.1 and secondary acceptance corroboration
claims.source_grounding_reason: 7.1 verified; report supplies no exact older-page or implementation URL in current carrier, so full cross-version identity is not independently established.

claims.statement: Reviewer list alone does not establish branch-policy satisfaction
claims.source_grounding_reason: Votes and policy evaluations are distinct.

claims.statement: PR statuses endpoint is 7.1, separate from policy evaluations, with vso.code/vso.code_status listed
claims.source_grounding_reason: Schema/API distinction and listed scopes are supported.

claims.statement: Statuses do not return build/min-reviewer/comment-resolution policy evaluations
claims.source_grounding_reason: Separate resources and semantics; no-status cannot be read as absence of policies.

claims.statement: Read-only client must query both families and label sources
claims.source_grounding_reason: Strong brief-fit recommendation for checks coverage, not a universal provider mandate or mandatory visual layout.

claims.statement: Highest-severity risk is no-checks UI from reading statuses alone
